dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Good morning! Did you sleep well?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.answer: Yes, I did. What's for breakfast?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, yaxshi uxladim. Nonushtaga nima bor?
options: Yes, I did. What's for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: Roommate
dialogue.text: Do you have any clothes that need washing?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Yes, I have a few shirts. Can I add them to your load?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, bir nechta ko'ylagim bor. Sening kiringga qo'shsam bo'ladimi?
options: Yes, I have a few shirts. Can I add them to your load?

dialogue.speaker: Partner
dialogue.text: What should we make for dinner tonight?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: How about pasta? We have all the ingredients.
options: How about pasta? We have all the ingredients.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Could you take out the trash? It's getting full.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.answer: Sure, I'll do it right now.
options: Sure, I'll do it right now.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We're running low on milk and eggs.

dialogue.speaker: Partner
dialogue.answer: I'll stop by the store on my way home from work.
options: I'll stop by the store on my way home from work.

dialogue.speaker: Roommate
dialogue.text: The apartment is getting messy. Should we clean this weekend?
dialogue.text_uz: Kvartira iflos bo'lib qoldi. Dam olish kunlari tozalaylikmi?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Good idea. I'll vacuum if you do the dishes.
dialogue.answer_uz: Yaxshi fikr. Sen idishlarni yuvasan, men changyutgich tortaman.
options: Good idea. I'll vacuum if you do the dishes.

dialogue.speaker: Partner
dialogue.text: Did you remember to pay the electricity bill?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Yes, I paid it online yesterday. The receipt is in my email.
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, kecha onlayn to'ladim. Kvitansiya emailimda.
options: Yes, I paid it online yesterday. The receipt is in my email.

dialogue.speaker: Family member
dialogue.text: The dog needs to go outside. Can you take him?
dialogue.text_uz: It tashqariga chiqishi kerak. Olib chiqasanmi?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: Of course! I'll grab the leash and take him to the park.
dialogue.answer_uz: Albatta! Tasmasini olib, parkka olib boraman.
options: Of course! I'll grab the leash and take him to the park.

dialogue.speaker: Partner
dialogue.text: What time do you need to wake up tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: I have an early meeting, so I need to be up by 6 AM.
dialogue.answer_uz: Ertalab yig'ilishim bor, shuning uchun soat 6:00 da turishim kerak.
options: I have an early meeting, so I need to be up by 6 AM.

dialogue.speaker: Family member
dialogue.text: Want to watch a movie together tonight?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.answer: That sounds great! You pick the movie, I'll make popcorn.
dialogue.answer_uz: Juda yaxshi! Sen kinoni tanla, men popkorn qilaman.
options: That sounds great! You pick the movie, I'll make popcorn.
